Definition: from G1909 and G363; to remind of:--put in mind.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says he wrote boldly to the Romans as putting them in mind in Romans 15:15 — reminding them of what they already knew, because of the grace given to him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe reminding is a ministry — most of what I need I already know, and I forget it anyway, so God sends men like Paul to put me in mind again.
